Success ek safar hai, manzil nahi.
"Time limited hai—waste mat karo."
Mindset achievement ka engine hai.
Aaj ka shaq, kal ki rukawat.
"Khud par believe karo—unstoppable."
"Words actions ban jaate."
Darr se mat dabo.
"Nayi idea se mind stretch hota, phir pehle jaisa nahi rehta."

"Sabse bada risk: risk na lena."

Chahe 'kar sakta' socho, ya 'nahi'—
